title: Stock Market Today Live, Sept 8: Sensex drops over 500 points, Nifty near 23,650 as US-Iran tensions and crude weigh, Nifty Defence hits record high - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 8th September 2026.

Indian equity markets traded weak in range-bound deals on Tuesday, as elevated crude oil prices, continuing US-Iran tensions and mixed global cues kept investors cautious.

At 1.29 p.m., the Sensex fell 509.41 points, or 0.67 per cent, to 75,623.41, while the Nifty declined 129.70 points, or 0.55 per cent, to 23,649.45.

Brent crude has climbed to around $97 a barrel, breaking above a range it had held for four sessions, amid concerns over prolonged supply disruptions linked to tanker attacks and risks around the Strait of Hormuz. OPEC+ has kept output unchanged, leaving limited additional supply buffers.

Asian markets are mixed, with Japan’s Nikkei largely flat and South Korea’s Kospi gaining over 0.5%. Analysts expect domestic markets to remain under pressure in the absence of strong local triggers.

Technically, the Nifty has formed a bearish candle with a lower high and lower low, indicating continuation of the corrective decline. Sustaining below 24,025 could trigger further downside towards 23,600-23,500, while 24,150 remains the immediate resistance level.

* Immediate support: 23,700, followed by 23,600

* Immediate resistance: 23,700; stronger resistance at 23,750

* Key breakout zone: A sustained move above 23,750–23,800 could ease the downside pressure.

* Nifty Futures resistance: 23,820 and 23,870

* Market breadth: Advances/declines at 15:35, indicating strong negative breadth.

* Trend: Bearish while Nifty remains below 23,750–23,800.

* Downside trigger: A decisive break below 23,700 could open the way towards 23,600.

* Futures bias: Negative below 23,820, with further weakness likely below 23,700.

* Positional trade: Short position from 23,904; revised stop-loss at 23,840, to be progressively trailed as outlined.

* Support: 23,700 / 23,600 | Resistance: 23,750 / 23,820 | Trend: Bearish.

Ganesha Recycling Chain Private Ltd, a material subsidiary of Race Eco Chain, has approved the allotment of 93,379 0.01% compulsorily convertible cumulative preference shares (CCPS) of face value of ₹10 each for an aggregate consideration of ₹4.66 crore to the company.

Jupiter Wagons Ltd, a provider of comprehensive mobility solutions encompassing rail, road and marine transportation, has secured a significant order from GATX India Private Ltd, a subsidiary of GATX Corporation, US, further strengthening its presence in India’s private wagon leasing ecosystem. Jupiter Wagons has signed a ₹97.66 crore (including applicable tax) wagon purchase agreement with GATX India Private Ltd. Shares were flat at ₹243.50 on the NSE.

OmniScience Capital expects India to benefit from rising FPI allocations; overweight on financial services, power and housing finance for the long term

According to OmniScience Capital, the recent shift in foreign portfolio investor (FPI) flows towards Indian equities could mark the beginning of a broader sentiment turnaround. Vikas Gupta, CEO and Chief Investment Strategist at OmniScience Capital, believes the consistent inflows seen in July and August could represent an initial move by global investors to diversify into non-AI assets.

Gupta said this could benefit India as global emerging-market allocations remain skewed towards Taiwan and South Korea, while India remains severely under-allocated despite being the fastest-growing major economy across emerging markets, Asia and the world.

S&P Global Ratings on Tuesday assigned 'BBB' long-term rating to Bank of India (BoI) on sufficient capitalisation, solid funding, and healthy liquidity.

Aluminium futures show a bullish trend, targeting ₹356, with strong support at ₹342 for potential gains.

Datamatics announced another interesting phase of its digital transformation engagement with a leading integrated pet care company from the USA; operating 30+ veterinary centres, grooming, day-care, boarding, and wellness services.

Bajaj Finance Ltd., part of Bajaj Finserv Ltd. and India’s largest private sector non-banking financial company, has acquired a 5% stake in TrueFan AI (Hogwarts E-learning Universe Private Limited), an AI-powered video generation platform.

The investment is part of Finserv Intelligence, Bajaj Finserv’s group-wide strategic initiative in applied research and innovation focussed on developing and supporting high-tech, scalable solutions, built in India, for India and the world.

The initiative will also enable Bajaj Finance to invest in technology startups, with a focus on early-stage companies, from seed to Series B that demonstrate strong innovation and scalability potential across AI, cybersecurity, quantum technologies, fintech, and consumer technology.

The investment in TrueFan AI builds on an existing commercial relationship between the two companies. Bajaj Finance has deployed TrueFan’s platform at scale, generating millions of personalized videos for customer engagement and dealer enablement initiatives. It also supports Bajaj Finance’s broader strategy of deploying AI-led automation and personalisation across its digital ecosystem.

Rajeev Jain, Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Bajaj Finance, said, “As a FINAI company, we are deploying AI at scale across the company. Our investment in TrueFan AI follows sustained, production-scale use of its technology, giving us first-hand experience of the platform’s capabilities and its execution. This investment reflects our commitment to supporting proprietary AI innovation in India and our belief in TrueFan’s potential to drive enterprise adoption of AI-powered communication.”
